records.text: In discussing Ukraine’s 2014 revolution, Owens played John McCain’s December 2013 address to Kyiv protesters and characterized it as preceding a U.S.-backed overthrow of President Viktor Yanukovych
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Like back in 2014, the Ukrainians were authentically and truly just done with their president, Yanukovych. ... And when John McCain went over there and led the protesters in the streets, he was really representing the voice of the people. ... It was not another United States military color revolution.

verification.notes: The episode verifies that Owens made this characterization and played the McCain address. IRI’s primary record dates McCain’s Kyiv protest speech to December 15, 2013, during the period later discussed as Ukraine’s 2014 revolution. The true result applies to the attributed characterization and corrected chronology; it is not evidence that the United States engineered Yanukovych’s removal.
